description: The Chitauri come through a portal above Stark Tower and six Avengers close it from the inside.
The Black Order and the Outriders hit the Wakandan shield line to reach the Mind Stone.
Stark, Strange, Parker, Quill, Drax, Mantis and Nebula attempt to take the gauntlet from Thanos and lose it to a temper.
Every restored hero and every army Thanos brought fight over a single compound and a single gauntlet.
The Avengers evacuate a city lifted into the sky while Ultron tries to drop it.
The two halves of the Avengers fight over a quinjet and a fugitive, twelve against twelve.
Zod terraforms Earth above Metropolis and Superman fights him through the streets of the city.
Batman intercepts a Kryptonite shipment and meets Superman for the first time, badly.
The Trinity fights a Kryptonian monster that adapts to everything they do, and Superman dies doing it.
The Justice League stops Steppenwolf from uniting the Mother Boxes in a Russian village.

battle_name: Duel for the Throne of Atlantis
description: Arthur Curry challenges Orm in the ring of fire and takes the throne by combat.
Task Force X fights its way to a rooftop against Enchantress and her brother.
Doomsday and Superman fight to mutual destruction in the middle of Metropolis.
Bane breaks Batman back in the Batcave after a month of exhausting him.

location: The Anti-Monitor fortress, the dawn of time
description: The surviving heroes assault the Anti-Monitor in the distant past while the multiverse collapses.
The altered timeline war between Atlantis and Themyscira reaches its final battle.
HAMMER and the Dark Avengers assault the floating city of Asgard over Oklahoma.
The assembled heroes assault Doom castle at the end of the Secret Wars.
Earth and cosmic heroes assault Thanos after the Snap, and Nebula takes the gauntlet from him.

location: The Blue Area of the Moon
description: The X-Men fight the Imperial Guard over Jean Grey, and Jean chooses to die.
winner: X-Men (at the cost of Jean Grey)

description: The Defenders and the Hand fight in a collapsing skyscraper above a pit of dragon bone.
Thor and Loki resurrect Surtur so he can destroy Asgard, which is the plan.
The Guardians and the Nova Corps stop Ronan from destroying Xandar with the Power Stone.
The Guardians fight Ego at the core of his own planet with a bomb built from a battery.
Thanos takes the Reality Stone from the Collector and levels the station.
Not a battle at all: an exchange. Gamora dies for the Soul Stone.
A year of gang wars ends when the National Guard withdraws and the city is left to itself.
Ra al Ghul uses Batman contingency plans to take down the Justice League one at a time.
Every Corps arrives at Coast City to fight the Black Lanterns and Nekron.
The Sinestro Corps assaults Oa and the Green Lantern Central Power Battery.
The Justice League fights Darkseid and the Anti-Monitor on two fronts at once, with stolen godhood on the line.
The surviving heroes of two Earths assault Alexander Luthor and Superboy-Prime.
Deathstroke and Terra attack Titans Tower from the inside.
The old Justice League and the new generation of heroes fight over a prison camp, and a nuclear weapon ends it.
The Justice League assaults the Legion of Doom headquarters in the swamp.
The meteor shower that brought Clark Kent also brought Kryptonite and a decade of consequences.
Malcolm Merlyn uses a seismic device to level the Glades, and Team Arrow stops the second device only.
Slade Wilson brings an army of Mirakuru soldiers into Star City to break Oliver Queen.
The metahumans released by the particle accelerator explosion attack Central City at once.
Malekith converges the realms above Greenwich and Thor fights him across two worlds.
Steve Rogers exposes HYDRA inside SHIELD by broadcasting every secret file in the building.
The Winter Soldier escapes a UN bombing frame-up through a tunnel with a motorcycle.
Killmonger challenges T Challa for the throne in ritual combat and wins by throwing him over the falls.
The Lang family and a rebellion fight Kang exile army inside the Quantum Realm.
SWORD, Agatha Harkness and the Scarlet Witch fight over a reality made of grief.

battle_name: The Citadel at the End of Time
location: The Citadel at the End of Time
description: Two Loki variants reach the man who wrote the timeline, and one of them makes a choice.
Strange and Chavez flee the Scarlet Witch across universes, and the Illuminati of Earth-838 pay for it.
The X-Men stop Magneto from turning the world leaders on Liberty Island into mutants.
The X-Men assault Stryker base under the dam to stop Cerebro being used to kill every mutant.
A retro-style skirmish in which early Avengers and invaders fight over a rooftop device.
Wild Sentinels are sent to Genosha and kill sixteen million mutants in a single morning.
The X-Men hold an island off San Francisco against Norman Osborn Dark Avengers.
The Masters of Evil take the mansion and beat Hercules into a coma before the Avengers regroup.
Thor and Loki fight their way through Hel to reach Hela, and Loki does not come back.
A bar, a bounty and three factions, resolved with a chair and a metal arm.
The Hulk and the Abomination level a Harlem street before the Army contains it.
The Army corners Bruce Banner on a university campus and the Hulk comes out.
Thor is forced into the Grandmaster arena and discovers the champion is the Hulk.
Bane seals Gotham with a nuclear bomb and a class war, and holds it for months.
Two ferries of civilians and prisoners are given the detonators to each other, and both refuse.
Batman fights Ra al Ghul League through a warehouse to reach Rachel Dawes and the fear toxin.
Black Adam and the Justice Society fight Intergang and each other over a crown nobody should wear.
winner: Black Adam (reluctantly) and the Justice Society

description: Deathstroke attacks the team base during a leadership crisis.
Team Arrow assaults Ra al Ghul fortress to stop the League from deploying a bio-weapon.
Thanagarian forces invade Earth and Hawkman has to choose a side that fits neither.
The Green Lantern Corps holds a desert world against the Sinestro Corps for three weeks.
White Martian forces attempt to take Mars from the Green Martian survivors.
Carol Danvers, Thor and Captain America breach Thanos flagship at the height of the final battle.
Ebony Maw and Cull Obsidian attack the New York sanctum for the Time Stone.
Proxima Midnight and Corvus Glaive ambush Wanda and Vision at a railway station.
The Guardians return to a ruined Knowhere and rebuild it as a home, which is the nearest thing to a battle in it.
The Guardians assault the High Evolutionary laboratory to free his experiments.
The Scarlet Witch walks into the Illuminati hall and kills every member in it.
Wanda destroys the Darkhold and brings the mountain down on herself.
Doomsday lands on the Daily Planet building and the Trinity has to take it down in the city.
The X-Men and Magneto Brotherhood assault Stryker base under the dam.
Wonder Woman, Batman and Steve Trevor fight Ares above a burning airfield in Belgium.
Two Suicide Squad elements assault Jotunheim to destroy Project Starfish.
The Squad fights its way out of a prison it was never meant to leave.
A riot engineered to cover a kidnapping turns into a street war with a vigilante in the middle.
